newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's BMG launches Swiss franc Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's BMG launches Swiss franc Eurobonds.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco BMG said it has launched 50 million Swiss franc eight-year denominated Eurobonds.
The bank was the first Latin American issuer of an eight-year Swiss franc denominated Eurobond, said BMG's international director Helio Novaes.
The issue, approximately of $38 million, is part of a $200 million medium-term notes program whose first tranche was launched in July.
The bonds have put and call options at both the third and fifth years, the bank said. The spread for three years will yield 480 basis-points over Swiss treasuries, it added.
Credit Agricole was the lead manager, while Societe Generale, Socimer Capital Markets, Banque Paribas and ANZ banking group were the co-managers.
